title: Summer Lovin at Treetop | KEY.co
description_expanded: This exquisite beach house in Seacrest's Treetop Village is the ultimate retreat for families and friends. This pet-friendly haven features four bedrooms and three-and-a-half bathrooms, boasting luxurious finishes like detailed woodwork, shiplap, and hardwood floors. Two master suites with en suite bathrooms offer privacy and comfort, while a third bedroom with a tub/shower combo and a bunk room that sleeps up to 12 ensure ample space for everyone. The spacious living area, complete with a queen sleeper sofa and large smart TV, seamlessly connects to a fully equipped kitchen with quartz counters and a breakfast bar, making it perfect for gatherings. The large covered porch, outdoor shower, and lush landscaping add a touch of serenity and seclusion. Nestled between Alys and Rosemary Beach, Treetop Village offers a prime 30A location with two private entrances and easy access to the beach via tram service. Guests can enjoy the community pool, explore nearby shops and restaurants, or take the included bikes for a scenic ride along the coast. High-speed Wi-Fi ensures everyone stays connected, while the beautiful surroundings and top-notch amenities create an idyllic setting for creating lasting memories. This beach house isn't just a place to stay—it's an invitation to experience the best of Florida's Gulf Coast in style and comfort.
